item.title: Play On! tournament, concert to support Taber community centre
item.description: The Town of Taber is partnering with Play On! Canada to host its first-ever street hockey tournament March 27 and 28. Funds raised from the event will help reopen the community centre, which was significantly damaged in an explosion in December.
